text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'system-ui', '-apple-system', 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: Shaded: sweet spot, 1,024–2,048 tokens (full speed, pass under 400 ms). Dashed: the engine's 16k cap per pass, a safety limit, not a speed choice.
